name: Release 1 — five verified training and performance businesses
notes: Names, addresses and phone numbers come from ~/medspa-crm/ethr-partner-kit/kit.json, the ETHR partner kit Mustafa built and verified. Nothing here was looked up or filled in from memory.
No websites: the partner kit does not record one for any of these five, so the field is left out rather than guessed.
No coordinates: lat/lng are left out so geocode-release can resolve them through the portal's Places integration. The portal routes by street address until then.
All five start at 'new'. None has been walked in on, and no visit, contact or partnership is pre-filled.

Synaptyx and Core1 are healthcare businesses (healthcare: true in the kit). Every script here names equipment and session length only. Nothing claims what cryotherapy, compression or red light does to a body.
Nobody is paid per referral. No script offers or implies a commission, a kickback or a fee.
The offer wording is ETHR's own, unchanged: 'Your first visit for $25: cryotherapy, compression or red light' and 'A free cryotherapy session at ETHR LAB, every month'.
Equipment wording is taken from the partner kit: a whole-body cryotherapy chamber, about three minutes; a Ballancer Pro compression suit; red light.

Legacy Physical Therapy is NOT in this release. Mustafa visited it and handed out materials, but the partner kit holds no address or phone for it and a web search found no such business in these towns, so it is left out until he supplies the address rather than released against a guess.

businesses.name: Synaptyx Health and Performance Systems
businesses.address: 17W755 Butterfield Rd Ste 103, Oakbrook Terrace, IL 60181
businesses.talkingPoint: Nearest neighbour on Butterfield — a recovery room their athletes can walk into for $25, and a free monthly cryotherapy session for the staff.

script.opening: Hi, I'm here on behalf of ETHR LAB, the wellness and aesthetics studio on Route 83, about a mile from you. We're introducing ourselves to a few training and performance places nearby. Is the owner or whoever handles partnerships around?
script.introduction: ETHR LAB is at 1S550 IL-83, Unit A2, in Oakbrook Terrace. We have a whole-body cryotherapy chamber — a session is about three minutes — a Ballancer Pro compression suit, and red light.
script.value: Your athletes already train seriously, and a lot of them are student athletes who are in and out between practices. We'd like to offer your people their first visit for $25: cryotherapy, compression or red light. And for your staff, a free cryotherapy session at ETHR LAB, every month. We'd point our clients your way too — you're the closest performance clinic to us.
script.ask: Could I leave a few brochures where your athletes will see them, and would the owner be open to a short conversation another day?

objections.busy: No problem — I'll leave these with you. Is there a quieter time of day to catch the owner?
objections.notInterested: Understood, thanks for your time. I'll leave a brochure in case it's ever useful.
objections.alreadyPartnered: That's good to hear, and we're not asking you to drop anything. This is just a $25 first visit for your people and a free monthly session for your staff. I'll leave a brochure.

script.closing: Thanks very much. I'll note that we spoke and we'll check back in a few weeks.
script.followUp: Hi, I came by a few weeks ago for ETHR LAB, the studio on Route 83. I wanted to see whether the brochures have been any use, and whether anyone has taken up the $25 first visit yet.
